title: platform-weekly-blitz-routing-quota-pulse-2027-05-04
content:
Weekly blitz notes — platform engineering (control plane / routing / auth / quotas) — 2027-05-04

Attendees: Ravi Menon (owner), Mei Chen, Lucas Ortega, Samir Patel, Elena Ruiz (oncall), Jordan K. (observability) — drop-ins: Priya (SRE) for 15m

Purpose: short, sharp sync to surface regressions from last week's rollout, align on quota reconciliation work, rehearse routing fallbacks, and confirm auth rate-limiter mitigation plan. Focus is operational (not a feature deep-dive).

Agenda:
- Quick metrics snapshot (latency, quota backfills, auth error spike)
- Quota reconciliation: data drift investigation + hotfix plan
- Routing fallback rehearsal & policy tweak proposal
- Auth token ratelimit anomaly: triage and temporary mitigation
- Oncall handover + immediate action items

Summary / Highlights:
- Latency: 99p latency on control-plane RPCs rose from 110ms -> 180ms between 2027-05-01 02:00 and 2027-05-02 08:00 UTC; correlated with a large influx of small concurrent requests from a customer sandbox (ticket PLT-1897). Not production impacting but caused backlog in quota reconciler.
- Quota reconciliation backlog: CAD-queue grew to ~25k ops by morning; root cause appears to be an off-by-one in sequence checkpointing inside the reconciler when handling chunked delta uploads. Mei has a repro that triggers the drift reliably.
- Routing fallback: exercised canary fallback policy this morning against simulated zone failure. Behavior was mostly correct but discovered a race where session affinity wasn't cleared when fallback route chosen -> session requests intermittently hit drained nodes. Lucas proposed adding a short TTL-based affinity-expiry on fallback paths (30s).
- Auth rate-limit anomaly: auth service returned 429s for a small cluster of tokens belonging to a test integration. Investigation shows a misconfigured burst window in the edge rate limiter; Samir confirmed a config drift after recent deploy. Temporary mitigation: apply conservative burst cap for edge-tier for the next 48 hours (feature flagged).

Detailed notes:
1) Metrics snapshot (Jordan)\- Control-plane RPCs: p50 28ms, p95 92ms, p99 180ms (spike window)\- Quota reconciler queue length: steady at 200/day normally; spiked to 25k then backfilled to 1.2k after partial fix\- Auth 429 rate: 1.6% of auth calls from 02:00-09:00 (normally <0.01%)

2) Quota reconciliation deep dive (Mei)\- Repro steps: drop file chunk ordering + simulate concurrent clients -> reconciler checkpoint increments incorrectly causing missed deltas.\- Impact: missed quota credits for some customers (non-critical credits), reconciliation retried and generated backlog.\- Immediate plan: push hotfix to reconciler that enforces idempotent checkpoint updates (Mei -> PR ready: GH redwood/platform#784). Hotfix rollout window: 2027-05-05 03:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). Rollback plan: revert new checkpoint path and run manual backfill script.
\- Notes: need to update reconciliation e2e tests to include chunk reordering case. Action: Mei + Jordan to add test by 2027-05-11.

3) Routing fallback rehearsal (Lucas)\- Scenario: AZ failure simulation using chaos job; observed fallback route changed but old session affinity entry remained for up to 60s.\- Proposed change: introduce 30s affinity expiry on fallback edges + emit debug metric when affinity is forcibly cleared. Small config change, low risk.\- Action: Lucas to prepare config diff and rollout plan; target canary 2027-05-06, full rollout 2027-05-09 if green.

4) Auth ratelimit triage (Samir)\- Cause: edge-tier burst window config drift in k8s configmap after autodeploy.\- Temporary mitigation: apply conservative burst caps via rollout of feature-flagged config and patch in k8s (Samir). Also plan: add a config drift detector for rate-limiter configs (alert PLT-CFG-09).

5) Oncall handover (Elena)\- Items for next shift: watch reconciler backfill progress (ticket PLT-1897), monitor auth 429 rate (alert threshold lowered to 0.2% for next 24h), ensure canary for reconciler hotfix completes.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Is the chunking protocol version negotiated by client libraries compatible with new idempotent checkpoint fix? (Mei to validate with SDK owners by 2027-05-07)
- Should fallback affinity expiry be config default or opt-in per-route? Tradeoffs: shorter expiry = more cold starts for sticky sessions. Lucas will prototype per-route opt-in.

Action items (owner -> due):
- Mei: merge reconciler hotfix PR, coordinate canary rollout 2027-05-05 03:00 (due 2027-05-05)
- Jordan: add chunk-reordering e2e test and dashboard panel for reconciler headroom (due 2027-05-11)
- Lucas: prepare fallback-affinity config diff + canary run plan (due 2027-05-06)
- Samir: push conservative burst cap patch and create config-drift alert PLT-CFG-09 (due 2027-05-05)
- Elena: oncall watch + confirm backfill progress and escalate if >10% remaining after 12h (ongoing)

Notes to self / worklog snippets:
- Mei: "saw the bug after reproducing with 20k concurrent tiny deltas; checkpoint update path needs a CAS"
- Lucas: "affinity TTL seemed cleanest low-risk approach, will log metrics at debug level"
- Samir: "we should make rate-limiter config part of infra CI — can gate by checksum"

References / Links:
- PLT-1897: customer sandbox causing recon backlog (Jira)
- GH PR: redwood/platform#784 (reconciler idempotency fix)
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PLTFM/Quota+Reconciliation+Runbook

Quick decisions made:
- Hotfix go-ahead for reconciler (canary 05-05)
- Temporary conservative burst cap for edge-tier auth (48h)
- Prototype fallback-affinity TTL (30s) as opt-in per-route

Risks / follow-ups:
- Backfill speed: current manual backfill will increase load on DB; coordinate with infra to throttle if DB CPU > 70% during backfill window (Jordan to monitor).
- SDK compatibility with checkpointing fix could require a minor patch release; track SDK owners response.

Next sync: quick check-in scheduled 2027-05-06 10:00 UTC (15m) to confirm hotfix canary result. Full weekly recap next Monday 2027-05-10.

Scratch / raw items (notes to capture quickly)
- TODO: add reconciler tracing span around checkpoint write
- TODO: add metric: fallback_affinity_forced_clears_total
- TODO: create postmortem template for quota drift incidents

End of notes.
